parameters.query:
SELECT e.id AS entite_id, ex.id AS exercice_id, e.code
FROM entite e
JOIN exercice ex ON ex.entite_id = e.id AND ex.cloture = false
WHERE e.code = '{{ $json.code }}'
ORDER BY ex.date_debut DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
-- T014 : MERGE staging → fec_ecriture
-- Anti-doublons via hash_md5
INSERT INTO fec_ecriture (
  entite_id, exercice_id, fec_import_id,
  journal_code, journal_lib, ecriture_num, ecriture_date,
  compte_num, compte_lib, comp_aux_num, comp_aux_lib,
  piece_ref, piece_date, ecriture_lib,
  debit, credit, ecriture_let, date_let, valid_date,
  montant_devise, idevise, pcg_numero, hash_md5
)
SELECT
  entite_id, exercice_id, fec_import_id,
  journal_code, journal_lib, ecriture_num, ecriture_date,
  compte_num, compte_lib, comp_aux_num, comp_aux_lib,
  piece_ref, piece_date, ecriture_lib,
  debit, credit, ecriture_let, date_let, valid_date,
  montant_devise, idevise, pcg_numero, hash_md5
FROM _staging_fec
ON CONFLICT (hash_md5) DO NOTHING;

-- Résoudre pcg_numero via resolve_compte()
UPDATE fec_ecriture
SET pcg_numero = resolve_compte(compte_num)
WHERE pcg_numero IS NULL
  AND entite_id = '{{ $json.entite_id }}';

parameters.query:
-- T015 : Stats import
UPDATE fec_import
SET
  nb_lignes_brut = {{ $json.nb_lignes_brut }},
  nb_lignes_inserees = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fec_ecriture
    WHERE fec_import_id = '{{ $json.fec_import_id }}'
  ),
  duree_secondes = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - date_import)),
  statut = 'termine'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.fec_import_id }}';

-- T017 : Refresh toutes les vues matérialisées
SELECT refresh_all_views();
